facts.fact: Peacock generates more than 15 million hours of ad-supported viewing every day, according to NBCUniversal's own description of the platform.
facts.quote: Peacock generates more than 15 million hours of ad-supported viewing every day

facts.fact: Per Nielsen Streaming Platform Ratings (P2+ duplication, 3-month average), 64% of Peacock viewers are not reached on competitors' ad-supported tiers; NBCUniversal cites this third-party figure.
facts.quote: Nielsen Streaming Platform Ratings, P2+ Duplication, 3-month average (Dec’25-Feb’26)

facts.fact: NBCUniversal's own aggregated data across 374 Peacock campaigns reports a +36% brand impact lift driven by Peacock compared with CTV norms.
facts.quote: Peacock Impact Results Across 374 campaigns from 10/1/24-9/30/25

facts.fact: NBCUniversal's own aggregated search data across 83 campaigns and 66 brands reports a +22% search activity lift driven by Peacock compared with CTV norms, measured via EDO.
facts.quote: Search Lift (Online Engagement Rate) Across 83 Campaigns, 66 Brands from 10/1/24-9/30/25

facts.fact: NBCUniversal states that Peacock ad innovations drive 1.7x higher ROAS than standard media; the page gives no source or time period for this vendor claim.
facts.unit: x higher ROAS vs standard media
facts.quote: driving 1.7x higher ROAS than Standard media

facts.fact: Per Marketcast (P18+), Contextual Pause Ads drive 23% higher memorability than Pause Ad norms, based on n=1316 across the listed advertisers.
facts.unit: % higher memorability vs Pause Ad norms
facts.quote: Marketcast, P18+, Pause ads includes Xfinity, State Farm, Simply Spiked, Target, Lexus n=1316. 2/17/23 – 4/27/23

facts.fact: Per BrightLine advertiser campaign data, Engagement Ads for units with NBCU IP have a 114% higher interaction rate than units without NBCU IP; the page notes BrightLine norms are not Peacock-specific.
facts.quote: BrightLine norms are not Peacock specific.

facts.fact: The Spotlight ad format delivers a brand's ad, on a day the advertiser chooses, to all Peacock viewers across all content in the first standard ad break, for 24 hours.
facts.quote: On the day of your choosing, your ad is delivered to all Peacock viewers across all content in the first standard ad break

facts.fact: The Arrival Ad is an exclusive first-view placement on Peacock's profile selection page, shown at the start of the Peacock experience.
facts.quote: exclusive first-view placement on Peacock’s profile selection page

facts.fact: NBCUniversal will allow clients to buy Peacock's premium Pause Ads programmatically, starting with PG deals, as one of the new ad innovations coming in 2026.
facts.quote: NBCU will now allow clients to buy Peacock’s premium Pause Ads programmatically, starting with PG deals.
